title: Gate all nested choice prerequisite refs
description:
Finding source:
- Fable found five dangling pact-boon refs under feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations choices[].options[].prerequisites[].ref.
- Existing ref-integrity gates evidently did not traverse that nested path.

Acceptance criteria:
- Extend ref traversal to choices[].options[].prerequisites[].ref and all adjacent nested reference-bearing fields.
- Add regression tests for Eldritch Invocation pact-boon prerequisites.
- Gate reports full JSON paths and candidate fixes for dangling refs.
close_reason: Satisfied by PR #383 (with eshyra-o9bd.18.4): reference-integrity traverses choices[].options[].prerequisites[] (classRef/featureRef/cantrip ref) with full JSON paths; ownership gate lists offering features on mismatch; regression tests added.
